parts.note_add: Runs under the floor from the tank-side fuel pump and filter to the engine bay, held by pipe clips and a pipe protector (catalogue figure 4500A-1). No reproduction steel line for the 1981-82 carburetted car was found; Inline Tube makes only the 1984-85 GSL-SE main line (5/16 in).
Carries surplus fuel from the carburettor back to the tank; the factory manuals show the return hose on the tank fitting beside the main hose.
Carries tank vapour forward to the charcoal canister through the check and cut valve (1985 manual 4A-3 schematic); leak test is the U-tube pressure test in the specs.
Rubber hoses joining the steel pipes to the tank, fuel pump, filter and fuel cut valve; all are pushed fully onto their fittings and secured with clips.

Bolted on its own bracket in the feed line after the fuel pump, with a 'from fuel pump' inlet and a 'to carburetor' outlet marked by arrows on the body (1980 and 1985 manuals). Mazda still lists 3919-45-170A, shared with B-series trucks and the 626.

Evaporative line leak test: U-tube water column applied at the canister ventilation hose
specs.note: 1985 manual. Blind the inlet and wait 5 minutes; if the level stays in the marked band the line is good, otherwise look for leaks at the evaporative line, tank, fuel line or filler cap.

Fuel cut valve ports: inlet 'from fuel pump', outlet 'to carburetor', flow arrows on the valve body; fit hoses to the arrows
